name: Recent interactive logons (Windows)
description: Lists recent interactive, RDP and cached logons from Security event 4624 and the last use time of each local profile. Reports clearly if the Security log is unreadable.

params.name: days
params.label: Days to look back
params.description: How many days of Security log to scan.

params.name: limit
params.label: Maximum events
params.description: Maximum number of logon events to list.

output: Logon table (time, account, type, source) followed by per-profile last use. Exit 0 always; exit 2 on invalid parameters.
